event_comments:
For corrections, email ing.uhlin@gmail.com
Note: The Finish was placed incorrectly in the beginning of the race, and then moved to the correct location, which affected the UOM class of the competitive classes.
Therefore, the leg 14-F was voided for the class UOM and the final times adjusted.
The leg 14-F is still visible in RouteGadget for class UOM but one should be able to draw and save routes.
The last leg (#14 to Finish) was voided for this class and the final times adjusted to the time at #14.
